title: Beacon Stairs Above Silence: Hidden Law
description: Beacon Stairs Above Silence unfolds across floating beacon stairways with glass bridges and radiant lock sigils, pushing a 5-Titan Empyrean squad to prove protection, order-locks, shields, anti-chaos control, formationless aura play. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Beacon Stairs Above Silence: Hidden Law advances Empyrean Choir Vault: The Radiant Hierarchies ascend a broken heaven-engine where order can stabilize worlds or erase dissonant survivors. It directly tests the faction tension: Their mercy is real, but so is their judgment. Allies fear becoming evidence in an Empyrean trial.
terrain: floating beacon stairways with glass bridges and radiant lock sigils

objectives.primary: Cleanse the Gate wound without breaking Empyrean realm law.
optional: Keep at least four Titans standing
Trigger at least two Empyrean faction mechanics

enemyWaves.entry: emerge through angelic order pressure fractures
reinforcement from the Gate wound flank

specialRules: Choir Lock: beacon timing shields formation if objectives resolve in order.
Radiant Edict: structured actions reduce chaos effects and protect allies.
victoryConditions: Cleanse the Gate wound without breaking Empyrean realm law.
